name: forge-edfi
description: Ed-Fi Data Standard forge bundle — parses the Ed-Fi MetaEd model (DS 5.2 + TPDM) and the descriptor code-value XMLs and emits the universal forge property contract (DmeClass/DmeProperty/DmeOptionSet/DmeOptionValue roles, synthetic edfi:<kind>/<key> stableIds, voyage-4-large embeddings). Carries NO CEDS cross-refs: the CEDS-authored crosswalk is retired (2026-10-02, TQ rulings 2026-09-10 and 2026-10-01)
